The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f79236c22b981fe6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a fixed finite set of rational primes SE with the following properties. Let p / ∈ SE, let v be any place of F above p, normalized by v(p) = 1, and let n, n′ ∈ Z, with n′ ̸= 0. Assume nP, n′P reduce to O at v. Then v  z(nP) z(n′P)  = vp(n/n′ ). (2.6) For every integer K ≥ 1, if in addition p > K + 1 and vp(n/n′) ≥ 0, then ℓK(z(n′P)) ̸= 0 and v  ℓK(z(nP)) ℓK(z(n′P)) − n n′  ≥ K. (2.7) Both assertions also hold at the same place v after replacing E, P, ℓK by Eσ, Pσ, ℓσ K and imposing the corresponding reduction-to-O hypotheses on the conjugate points. Here and below the valuation of zero is +∞, so n = 0 is included.
